Core implementation map:
- src/App.tsx
- src/parser/lexer.ts
- src/parser/parser.ts
- src/parser/ast.ts
- src/parser/index.ts
- src/semantics/analyzer.ts
- src/semantics/iom.ts

- src/editor/IsomorphEditor.tsx

Validation map:
- tests/lexer.test.ts
- tests/parser.test.ts
- tests/semantics.test.ts
- tests/renderer.test.ts
- tests/examples.test.ts
- tests/dsl_features.test.ts

Recommended local verification commands:
- npm run typecheck
- npm run test
- npm run build

Notes:
- Runtime parser and lexer are hand-written in src/parser. The ANTLR grammar is reference documentation.
- Bidirectional behavior is centered in src/App.tsx and src/components/DiagramView.tsx.
